capabilities: Create projects with frontmatter and tags
Assign tasks to workflows from any note
Manage subprojects in a main project
View and manage all tasks on one Manage Page
disambiguation: Not a tag-organizing or tag-cleanup tool; it uses tags to define workflows and manage project tasks.
extras: The author plans to remove the Dataview dependency in the future; tutorials and templates are available on an official website and in the plugin's built-in Help Page.
intentEvidence: Tag Project extends Dataview, giving you freedom to manage projects and track progress anywhere in your Obsidian vault.
motivation: The author states no Obsidian plugin solved the combination of spread-out tasks, single-page management, and predefined workflows, so they built it themselves.
problem: Tasks are scattered across notes in a vault, and Obsidian has no built-in way to view and manage them together on a single page.

relations.evidence: Tag Project extends Dataview, giving you freedom to manage projects and track progress anywhere

summary: Project management plugin that gathers tagged tasks from across the vault into one Manage Page, organized by user-defined workflows.
